note: All pages hand-written (no generator). Seeded pages contain exactly one intended markup defect each; clean pages are valid, modern HTML and must produce no findings.

seeded.what: duplicate id="verdict" on two elements (breaks in-page #verdict link)
invalid nesting: interactive <a> inside <a> (browsers split the outer link; affiliate link unreliable)
img without alt inside a hidden container (axe skips it because it is not rendered; becomes visible when JS is off)
stray end tag with no matching open tag
label for= points to a non-existent id (textarea unlabelled for screen readers; clicking label does nothing)

clean.features: custom element <pet-calculator>, data-* attributes, <datalist>, <output for>, <template> with <tr>, <dialog> with method=dialog form, module script
inline SVG with role=img + aria-labelledby title/desc, data-* on SVG, <picture>/<source>, img decoding/loading, download link
<details name=> exclusive accordion, <summary>, data-* attrs, aria-pressed buttons, <time>
